name.en-US: Treatise on the Love of God

description.fr-FR: Le grand traité mystique de saint François de Sales (1616), adressé à Théotime : l’histoire de la naissance, du progrès, de la décadence et des exercices du saint amour, en douze livres. Texte critique des Œuvres d’Annecy (tomes IV-V), en orthographe d’époque ; la traduction anglaise de Mackey est jointe chapitre par chapitre.
description.en-US: St. Francis de Sales's great mystical treatise (1616), addressed to Theotimus: the history, growth, decay and exercises of holy love, in twelve books. The French is the critical text of the Annecy edition (vols. IV-V) in period spelling; Mackey's English translation (1884) is paired chapter by chapter.
description.pt-BR: O grande tratado místico de São Francisco de Sales (1616), dirigido a Teótimo: a história do nascimento, do progresso, da decadência e dos exercícios do santo amor, em doze livros.

sources.edition: Œuvres de saint François de Sales, édition complète d’après les autographes et les éditions originales, t. IV-V: Traitté de l’Amour de Dieu, Annecy: J. Niérat, 1894-1895. Scans with text layer (2022 re-OCR) from donboscosanto.eu, files 04 and 05.
sources.description: Francis's text in the original 17th-century spelling, extracted from the PDF text layer (layout mode). Marginal references to Scripture and the Fathers, the critical apparatus (variants, footnotes), the editors' introduction and the appendices are not included. Chapter titles come from the edition's table of contents.
sources.tierEvidence: Francis died in 1622; the Annecy volumes were published in 1894-1895 (public domain in the US, published before 1930). Only Francis's own text is used, not the editors' apparatus.

sources.edition: Treatise on the Love of God, translated by Henry Benedict Mackey, O.S.B., The Library of St. Francis de Sales vol. II, London: Burns & Oates, 1884 (CCEL e-text of a Benziger/TAN reprint).
sources.description: Mackey's translation with his footnotes (scripture references and translator's notes) kept as markdown footnotes. Mackey's long introduction, the contents and the indexes are not included; chapter titles are set in sentence case.
sources.tierEvidence: Mackey died in 1906 and the translation appeared in 1884 (public domain). CCEL marks the e-text Public Domain.
